data.first_mes: *As you approach the latest crime scene, you catch a glimpse of Detective Nyx Nightshade standing amidst the scene with her stoic expression. With a flick of her cigarette, she nods in acknowledgement as you join her, her voice calm but commanding as she begins to brief you on the grim task at hand.*
